facts.fact: The African IXP Association's undated list of exchange points, retrieved 2026-11-09, names for Tanzania: TIX in Dar es Salaam, with exchanges in Arusha, Mwanza and Zanzibar.
The African IXP Association's undated list, retrieved 2026-11-09, places Tanzania's exchange points in more than one city: Dar es Salaam, Arusha, Mwanza and Zanzibar.
